thread.potential_issue: RUNNABLE count is high; confirm whether threads are on-CPU or blocked in native I/O.
thread.recommendations: Correlate with host CPU. Inspect RUNNABLE stacks for EPoll.wait versus busy loops.

gc.resource_warning: real > usr + sys on some pauses (CPU throttle or slow log I/O).
recommendations: Cap MaxGCPauseMillis to a realistic target.
Write GC logs to local disk, not network storage.

memory.leak_suspects: Worker threads retaining large object graphs.
recommendations: Confirm GC roots in MAT Path to GC Roots.

overall_diagnosis.system_status: Stable, with latent resource and memory-retention risks.
overall_diagnosis.main_issue: GC pauses amplified by CPU contention; heap retained by request-scoped collections.
recommended_actions: Re-capture dumps after the change to verify.
